set.tovw: Grade F (treasure thread): the can was dug up in 1906; look-only history marker
set.pl: Terrell's own land on the W bank of the Iowa River in the SW1/4 of sec 3 T79N R6W, across the river from the mill (Terrell Mill Park is on the E bank). The 1887 will lists the homestead in lots 3-4 of sec 3 and the SW fractional quarter of sec 3 W of the river.
pinev: 1887 will land description (Johnson Co will book pp.252-253) + BLM PLSS sec 3 T79N R6W; the find was 'across the river from the mill', so W-bank part of sec 3; r350

tw-ia-iowa-city-terrell-can-1906.st: His 1887 will left the homestead by the Iowa River, timber land, $3,000 in cash and bank stock to his wife and daughter; it excused the executors from filing an inventory, so the buried can was never listed.
src: Johnson Co IA will book pp.252-253, will of Walter Terrell (Iowa Wills and Probate, Ancestry, PC (b)); research/ancestry/bennett-terrell-iowa.md

pinev: GLO patents 1865-1873 to the 1880s farm owner named in the Grand Rapids Herald 1887: secs 4 and 9 T34N R13W and sec 33 T35N R13W, the north-central part of South Fox Island (BLM PLSS, checked against the island's position; T35N sec 13 is North Fox and is excluded). Pin covers the three sections; the house is not located.
set.t: South Fox Island is reached only by boat; parts are state land (check DNR rules). Family tradition via a Fox Islands local history book. Access: island is private / restricted: permission.

src: BLM GLO patents, Leelanau Co MI, T34N R13W secs 4, 9 and T35N R13W sec 33 (PC (a))
